answer: Require each new agent to lock an escrowed deposit at registration, released only after a long cooldown of attested honest work. A sybil fleet must fund every clone from the same nebula of seed wallets, and each clone deposit sits idle at an inlet the attacker cannot drain until its reputation climbs to a trusted zenith. Flooding the network with fakes therefore costs real locked capital per head, and any detected collusion slashes those bonds, so the attack price scales linearly with fleet size instead of being free.
